overview.text: He campaigns on a platform he calls Radical Transparency, and proposes publishing all state spending on a public, real-time blockchain ledger and using artificial intelligence to audit for fraud. He wants to automatically withhold funds from programs that fail audits and require zero-based budgeting. He would prioritize audits of non-governmental organizations that receive state homelessness money. He opposes raising the minimum wage, arguing government mandates raise costs and kill jobs. He opposes a "split roll" revision to Proposition 13, saying it would harm California’s business climate. His campaign says the state’s budget masks a roughly $20 billion structural deficit.
